title: Unified description of color-electric and color-magnetic strings in hybrid vacua of $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric QCD
summary: We study non-Abelian strings supported in $r$-vacua of 4D $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetric QCD (SQCD) with gauge group $U(N)$ and $N_f$ quark hypermultiplets ($N_f\ge N$), where $r<N$ (scalar) quarks develop vacuum expectation values. At the quantum level, $N-r-1$ monopoles in the orthogonal sector of the gauge group also form a condensate. This leads to the formation of flux tubes (strings) that carry both color-electric and color-magnetic fluxes and confine quarks and monopoles, respectively.
